Facts:
- Porsche began a line of water-cooled front-engined rear-wheel-drive models with the Porsche 924 almost 20 years before the Porsche 968.
- The Porsche 944 was a front-engined, rear-wheel-drive mid-level model based on the Porsche 924 platform.
- The Porsche 944 was available as a coupé or cabriolet with either naturally aspirated or turbocharged engines.
- The Porsche 968 was the final evolution of Porsche's water-cooled front-engined rear-wheel-drive line.
- The Porsche 968 took over the entry-level position in Porsche's lineup from the Porsche 944.
- The Porsche 968 shared about 20% of its parts with the Porsche 944.
